name: H3 AV add-noise for resampling
plain: Noises a finished H3 audio-video latent to a chosen sigma, so a later sampler can continue from it with noise disabled. It treats the two streams separately since the sampler carries audio at a different scale. It asks the model's own sampling object for the formula, and refuses σ = 1 because that path would throw the input latent away.
math:
carry = shift_v/shift_a for audio, 1 for video.
noisy = noise_scaling(σ, ε, clean_in·carry); out = process_out(inverse_noise_scaling(σ, noisy)/carry).
ε is generated once for the whole nested latent, so seed and RNG order stay the NOISE object's. dtype promoted to at least float32.

family_fit.why: Raises unless latent format is MiniMaxH3AV with FLOW_AV sampling
